svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: One axis of light
svg.desc: A horizontal log-wavelength strip from 500 to 0.05 nm coloured by wavelength, with the exposure lines as ticks, the optic each band needs beneath it and the exposure eras pinned at their wavelength with the year their first tool model appears in the data set.
